## Problem and resulting change

Explain the concrete problem and how this change addresses it.

## Related issue / gate

Link the issue and gate, or explain why neither applies.

## Evidence and validation

State exactly what was checked and link the evidence. Distinguish targets from results.

## Review checklist

- [ ] `python scripts/check_repository.py` passes.
- [ ] Current status, roadmap and affected decision records agree with the change.
- [ ] Sources are attributed and no credentials or private data are included.
- [ ] Imported source snapshots are preserved, or an explicit reviewed provenance change explains the exception.
- [ ] Engineering changes have appropriate domain review; documentation checks are not hardware validation.

## Limitations / remaining work

Record unresolved assumptions and what this PR does not establish.
